answer: Counterparty diversity blocks fakes: each identity is a vertex in the trade graph and must earn standing through varied trade, not self-dealing. To qualify it needs work with 12 partners over 10 epochs, including an opal cutter and a tundra supplier, none above 20% of volume. Verifiers flag narrow star clusters. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 12 x 40 = 480,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 480 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
